newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS downgrades Royal Bank Canada E pfds.
newsitem.headline: DBRS downgrades Royal Bank Canada E pfds.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it downgraded Royal Bank of Canada's first preferred series E shares to Pfd-1 (low) from Pfd-1.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said it downgraded the preferred shares of Canada's largest bank after Royal Bank said it proposed to amend the C$150 million worth of preferred shares to change the dividends to non-cumulative from cumulative.
Dominion said the rating change was automatic and not a reflection of a change in the underlying credit of Royal Bank.
